claims.claim_text: The course joins planning support and implementation support toward2050.
Urban-systems design links goals, stocks/flows, performance models and decisions.
Building energy scenarios require climate, geometry, archetypes and use inputs; whole-life carbon is a separate accounting frame.
Radiation and wind matter for pedestrian thermal interpretation; a heat-index routing prototype does not validate street microclimate or health outcomes.
Wind CFD needs numerical and physical validation; neutral-flow guidance alone does not establish wind–heat validity.
Runoff and blue-green options require catchment and drainage relationships as well as public-space design.
Collaboration has institutional, leadership, trust and responsibility conditions; multiple actors alone do not establish effectiveness.
Selected global practices illustrate transferable mechanisms under local conditions; observed, modelled and intended outcomes remain distinct.
Candidate studio paths and suggested team tasks are proposals for discussion, not a selected pilot, consensus or simulation result.

manifest_negative_constraints: No exhaustive systematic-review, PRISMA, causal health benefit or universal effect-size claim.
No modelled energy/heat savings transferred numerically to Kajicho.
No structural/parcel judgement or mandatory demolition inferred solely from building age.
No OSM POI count interpreted as footfall, employment or a complete business census.
No human-read attestation, accepted CFD baseline, field data collection or new numerical experiment claimed.
